Influencer marketing · Colombia

# Influencer marketing in Colombia.

Creator campaigns for Colombian audiences on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, with SIC ad rules in every brief, and easy expansion to Mexico, Peru, Chile and the rest of Latin America.

[Get a free shortlist →](https://awisee.com/contact/)[Book a call](https://awisee.com/book-a-call/)

Tell us your product, market and budget. We send ten matched creators within 48 hours, free.

Social media**37.7M**

social media users in Colombia, 70.4% of the population.

[DataReportal, Digital 2026 Colombia](https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2026-colombia)

The numbers

## TikTok and Facebook reach the most people.

Platform ad reach from late-2025 data. Instagram reaches fewer people here than in Brazil or Argentina, so we rarely plan Colombia on Instagram alone.

**37.7M**

### TikTok

ad reach, 93% of adults in Colombia.

[DataReportal, Digital 2026 Colombia](https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2026-colombia)

**36.4M**

### Facebook

ad reach, 67.9% of the population.

[DataReportal, Digital 2026 Colombia](https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2026-colombia)

**31.0M**

### YouTube

ad reach, 57.9% of the population.

[DataReportal, Digital 2026 Colombia](https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2026-colombia)

**21.6M**

### Instagram

ad reach, 40.2% of the population.

[DataReportal, Digital 2026 Colombia](https://datareportal.com/reports/digital-2026-colombia)

The market

## A growing creator economy.

**650,000**

### Creators

content creators in Colombia, by an IAB estimate.

[Forbes Colombia, Dec 2025](https://forbes.co/2025/12/10/editors-picks/forbes-presenta-los-top-creators-de-colombia-2025)

**29%**

### Platform split

TikTok was the favourite platform for watching creators (29%), ahead of Instagram and YouTube (25% each).

[Ipsos via Portafolio, Feb 2025](https://www.portafolio.co/negocios/comercio/radiografia-de-los-influenciadores-en-colombia-623734)

**30M+**

### Regional reach

Medellín’s tourism campaign with six Colombian creators drew 30M+ early views across Latin America.

[Alcaldía de Medellín, Oct 2026](https://www.medellin.gov.co/es/?p=576699)

Platforms

## The platforms that work in Colombia.

[Platform

### TikTok

The biggest reach in Colombia, and the favourite platform for watching creators.

Explore →](https://awisee.com/tiktok-influencer-marketing/)[Platform

### YouTube

Reviews, tutorials and integrations for products people research first.

Explore →](https://awisee.com/youtube-influencer-marketing/)[Platform

### Instagram

Reels and Stories for fashion, beauty, food and travel brands.

Explore →](https://awisee.com/instagram-influencer-marketing/)[Platform

### Kick

Live streams with Spanish-speaking streamers for gaming and entertainment.

Explore →](https://awisee.com/kick-influencer-marketing-agency/)

Ad rules

## What Colombia expects from sponsored posts.

01

### The SIC guide

The SIC’s 2020 guide asks influencers to label paid content as advertising, in Spanish and as visible as the main message. It is guidance, based on Colombia’s consumer statute.

[SIC guide, 2020](https://kreab.com/bogota/wp-content/uploads/sites/9/2020/10/guia-de-buenas-practicas-superintendencia.pdf)

02

### Enforcement is real

In 2023 the SIC opened investigations into companies linked to influencers, including over undisclosed commercial ties.

[Xataka Colombia, Jul 2023](https://www.xataka.com.co/legislacion-y-derechos/sic-abrio-millonaria-investigacion-cuatro-influenciadores-colombia-publicidad-enganosa-asi-han-respondido)

03

### A new law is coming

A Senate bill on content creators would require labels such as “Publicidad”. It passed its first debate in 2025 and is still pending.

[Senado de Colombia, Jul 2025](https://senado.gov.co/index.php/el-senado/noticias/6638-senado-le-apuesta-a-la-regulacion-de-la-actividad-de-los-
